settings.title: Simplifying Dance Floors
settings.text: No matter your venue’s surface—whether it’s grass, sand, concrete, or carpet—our Dance Floor Kits are designed to instantly transform any space into a vibrant dance floor. With a perfect balance of style and durability, this outdoor flooring solution combines quick, tool-free assembly with a weather-resistant design that stands strong through even the most energetic dance routines. Create a seamless dance dance floor that’s portable, reliable, and built for every celebration.

settings.title: Portable & Easy to Install
settings.text: Each 3′ x 3′ panel weighs just 18 lbs, making it easy to transport and install while providing a sturdy surface for dancing. Enjoy the perfect balance of lightweight portability and durable performance.

settings.title: No Walk Technology
settings.text: Our portable dance floor tiles comes with No walk peg bottom. With 840 support structures per square foot, your floor remains stable throughout the entire event.

settings.title: PowerLock Interlocking Technology
settings.text: Its locking system is the industry's most advanced and durable, designed for long-term performance. With four locks per edge, it ensures easy installation, removal, and durability across various terrains.

settings.title: How it works
settings.text:
Our Large Dance Floor Tiles are designed for versatility, making them ideal for outdoor bases like grass or sand thanks to their no-walk peg bottom. They can also be used indoors on thick, padded carpets. For indoor installations over thinner carpet, concrete, or hardwood, our XL and Plus Dance Floor Tiles with grid bottoms are the perfect fit.

Once your base is ready, simply choose the Dance Floor Kit that works for your event.

Each pre-assembled kit includes dance floor tiles and edging, giving you a complete dance floor solution. See the kit description for full inclusions and details.

In four simple and fast steps, you can have your surface fully installed in minutes or less.

Getting Started

The panels have two sides with female PowerLocks, and two sides with male PowerLocks. All tiles on any given installation should always have the female PowerLocks going in the same direction.

Step One

Begin the installation by laying down your first panel in any one corner and pointing the female PowerLocks in the two directions that additional panels are to be added.

Step Two

Place the next panel so that the male PowerLock line up over the top of the female loops on the first panel. It's important to make sure that the female PowerLocks are facing exactly the same direction as the first panel.

Step Three

Gently step along the joint of the two panels. You will hear and feel the PowerLocks snap into place as you go.

Step Four

Once the two panels are joined, repeat steps one through three remembering to keep the female PowerLocks aligned until your floor is complete. That's all there is to this easy-to-install flooring!
